subject: Harbor raises $10M seed to measure and insure AI agent risk for banks and insurers
text:
Source: https://harbor.ai/seed-announcement (also Insurance Journal https://www.insurancejournal.com/news/national/2026/10/13/888747.htm)
Why it fits: deals story with a named figure. Base10, Abstract and 8VC led the $10M seed round (13 Oct), and the company says it works with banks, insurers and other regulated firms. (Filed by Site Watch, relayed by Marc.)
